title: Underway to the Cascadia margin
author: Mika Thompson
excerpt: Departed Newport this morning; first station in ~18 hours.
body:
We left Newport at 0700 under clear skies. The deck is loaded with the first tranche of COSZO instruments and the team is settling into watch schedules.

First station is the Slope Base node, roughly 18 hours out.

title: First deployment at Slope Base
author: Geoff Cram
excerpt: The broadband seismometer is on the seafloor and reporting.
body: The broadband seismometer touched down at Slope Base at 1432 local. Telemetry came up within minutes and the first waveforms look clean.
